subject: Budget band validation + procurement path for Acorn Health pilot
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acornhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Budget band validation + procurement path for Acorn Health pilot

Hi Sam —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we’re aligned on next steps.

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Pilot scope: conversational triage + summarization for 10k active users/month, peak concurrency ~50.
- Estimated token profile: ~700 tokens per end-user session average (prompt + response), ~7M tokens/month (conservative) to ~12M tokens/month (upside).
- Primary success criteria: under 200ms median token latency for 95th pct, and < $3k/month infra incremental budget for pilot ops (excluding integration).

Preliminary unit economics (ballpark):
- Recommended model tier: medium-sized open model variant (quantized) — Redwood hosted.
- List $/1M tokens estimate: $250 — $400 depending on batching and KV cache enablement.
- For your 7M–12M tokens/mo range, estimated monthly spend (hosted API): $1,750 — $4,800 before discounts / PO terms.

Questions / asks for procurement path validation:
1) Can you confirm the monthly spend band you’re comfortable committing to for the pilot (choose a single band): 0–2.5k, 2.5k–5k, 5k–10k?
2) Procurement threshold: do you require an LPO/PO for any vendor > $5k/mo or is the threshold higher?
3) Do you have preferred billing cadence (monthly vs net-30/45)?
4) Who should we loop in from procurement for SOW/PO lead time estimates?

Next steps I propose (pending your answers):
- I’ll share a formal pricing estimate + SOW draft for the pilot (attached).
- If you confirm band and procurement threshold, Ben (cc’d) will run pricing scenarios including a short-term trial discount and a 3-month commit band option.
- Priyom will scope the platform onboarding checklist so we can hit the latency and caching knobs quickly.

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf (pdf), SOW-AcornHealth-draft.docx (docx)

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acornhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Acorn Health Procurement <procure@acornhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget band validation + procurement path for Acorn Health pilot

Thanks Steph — good summary. A few quick items from my side:

- Band confirmation: we’re comfortable targeting the 2.5k–5k/mo band for the first 2 months of the pilot; we may scale to 5k–10k if latency and accuracy meet expectations.
- Procurement threshold: procurement requires a PO for any vendor where monthly spend is expected to exceed $7,500 — our internal rule. So if you can keep pilot invoices below that, it reduces the paperwork cycle.
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices with Net-30 is preferred.
- Procurement lead: please include our procurement contact (procure@acornhealth.com) on the SOW and any contract drafts; they need ~10 business days to review and approve standard T&Cs.

One follow-up about unit economics — your $/1M token range is broadly in line with expectations. Could you give a short scenario for a 9M tokens/mo case (midpoint) with and without a 10% trial discount, and call out any one-time onboarding charges?

If you can send those numbers, I’ll share with procurement and schedule an internal sync.

— Sam

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Budget band validation + procurement path for Acorn Health pilot

Looping in — Ben here. Quick direction on pricing scenarios for Steph to send Sam:
- Provide a 9M tokens/mo breakdown: base list, with a 10% trial discount, and a 3-month commit option (5% additional).
- Include an explicit line for platform onboarding (one-time), itemized as: onboarding engineering hours (estimate 25 hrs) + configuration support + data retention config — target range $3k–$6k one-time.
- Show invoice examples that keep monthly charges under $7,500 when the trial discount is applied (so procurement can avoid PO delays).

Note: Priyom — highlight caching/batching levers we can enable quickly to reduce per-token billing in months 1–2.

Thanks,
Ben
VP Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Budget band validation + procurement path for Acorn Health pilot

Sam — thanks, attached is the requested 9M tokens scenario and a clean pricing estimate that factors in a 10% trial discount and a 3-month commit option. Key lines below for quick scanning:

Pricing snapshot (9M tokens/mo)
- List: $320 / 1M tokens → $2,880 / month
- With 10% trial discount: $2,592 / month
- With 10% trial + 5% 3-month commit: $2,462 / month
- One-time onboarding (25 hrs @ est): $4,250 (itemized in SOW)

With the 10% trial discount, monthly invoices remain under your $7,500 PO threshold. We can bill monthly (Net-30).

Next steps:
- Sam / procurement: please confirm that monthly Net-30 invoices are acceptable and share the procurement contact name + phone (procure@acornhealth.com is fine for docs but we prefer a direct contact for intake).
- If you confirm, we’ll prepare a short SOW and a starter invoice template for procurement review (DocuSign link included).

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf (pdf), SOW-AcornHealth-draft.docx (docx)
